Carrot and Hazelnut are best friends.

Today is a very special day because
they are going to watch a big
football match together!

They find their seats, but they
are way in the back and can't
see the ball well.

Carrot wishes they could see
better.

They wiggle through tall legs
and move down a few rows.

Now they have a good view, but
Carrot wants to get even closer.

Since nobody stops them, they
keep sneaking closer and closer.

They reach the very front row with
a great view, but Carrot keeps going.
Carrot runs right past the front row, all the way onto the grass!
Now they're right in the middle of the field!
All the players stop and stare at them.
The referee walks them back to Row C.
